search_metadata.title: Search metadata
search_metadata.description: Metadata that will be used to populate a search index. Simplified from datacite 4.6; in future we will add custom extra fields.

creators.title: Authors
creators.description: A list of authors (tip: use JSON list syntax if entering via the web UI, `[{"name": "Firstname Lastn"}]`)

title.title: Title
title.description: A short human-friendly title for this dataset

description.title: Description
description.description: A one-paragraph description shown in search results

publisher_name.title: Produced by
publisher_name.description: The name of the institution that produced the resource

id.title: Source Collection ID
id.description: The UUID for the collection which serves as the source of the data for the two-stage Transfer

path.title: Source Collection Path
path.description: The path on the source collection for the data
